model.name: Binary Orthogonal
model.description: A quadrant model using two conceptual axes (X and Y) to form four composite quadrant entities.

entities.name: {axis_x}
entities.define_prompt: The X-axis representing opposing conceptual vectors.

entities.name: {axis_y}
entities.define_prompt: The Y-axis representing another set of conceptual vectors.

entities.name: {x_positive}
entities.define_prompt: Positive direction on X-axis. (e.g., future on a time axis, advantage in a competition)

entities.name: {x_negative}
entities.define_prompt: Negative direction on X-axis. (e.g., past on a time axis, disadvantage in a competition)

entities.name: {y_positive}
entities.define_prompt: Positive direction on Y-axis. (e.g., growth, opportunity)

entities.name: {y_negative}
entities.define_prompt: Negative direction on Y-axis. (e.g., decline, threat)

entities.name: {quadrant_I}
entities.define_prompt: Find all of {ThinkPoint}= {x_positive} and {y_positive}

entities.name: {quadrant_II}
entities.define_prompt: Second quadrant (X negative, Y positive).

entities.name: {quadrant_III}
entities.define_prompt: Third quadrant (X negative, Y negative).

entities.name: {quadrant_IV}
entities.define_prompt: Fourth quadrant (X positive, Y negative).

model.name: Trinary Interconnection
model.description: A triangular model showing interaction among three conceptual entities.

entities.name: {node_a}
entities.define_prompt: Vertex A in the triangle.

entities.name: {node_b}
entities.define_prompt: Vertex B in the triangle.

entities.name: {node_c}
entities.define_prompt: Vertex C in the triangle.

model.name: Binary Negative Feedback Opposition
model.description: Two opposing nodes interact via negative feedback functions, driving the system toward a dynamic equilibrium.

entities.name: {node_a}
entities.define_prompt: Opposing Node A.

entities.name: {node_b}
entities.define_prompt: Opposing Node B.

entities.name: {equilibrium}
entities.define_prompt: Dynamic equilibrium point between Node A and Node B.

model.name: Venn diagram
model.description: Models the relationship between any sets, focusing only on their intersections and unions.

entities.name: {set}
entities.define_prompt: user defined set

model.name: Central Expansion Model
model.description: A model with a center (origin), expansion (radius), boundary (circumference), interior, and exterior. Relations include expansion and contraction.

entities.name: {origin}
entities.define_prompt: The central point (origin) of the circle.

entities.name: {boundary}
entities.define_prompt: The boundary (circumference) of the circle.

entities.name: {interior}
entities.define_prompt: The interior region within the boundary.

entities.name: {exterior}
entities.define_prompt: The exterior region outside the boundary.

model.name: 2D Hybrid Matrix
model.description: Matrix where row and column are defined by different sets, and each cell represents the intersection.

entities.name: {row_define_set}
entities.define_prompt: The set that defines all possible row entities (e.g., countries, products).

entities.name: {col_define_set}
entities.define_prompt: The set that defines all possible column entities (e.g., years, indicators).

entities.name: {dimension_row}
entities.define_prompt: Row dimension, each value is an entity from row_define_set.

entities.name: {dimension_col}
entities.define_prompt: Column dimension, each value is an entity from col_define_set.

entities.name: {cell_entity}
entities.define_prompt: A cell defined by the intersection of a row entity and a column entity.

model.name: 2D Symmetric Matrix
model.description: A symmetric matrix where both row and column are enumerations of the same set, and each cell represents a symmetric relationship.

entities.name: {define_set}
entities.define_prompt: The set that defines both row and column entities (e.g., countries, people).

entities.name: {dimension}
entities.define_prompt: Both row and column dimensions, each value is an entity from define_set.

entities.name: {cell_entity}
entities.define_prompt: Cell representing the symmetric relationship between two entities from define_set.
